resources.name: PZT-4 material constants

access.notes: Standard electromechanical constants for PZT-4 ceramic are available from published literature (e.g., Berlincourt et al., 'Piezoelectric and piezomagnetic materials', 1964; IEEE Standard 176). The required constants include elastic stiffnesses c^E_11, c^E_12, c^E_13, c^E_33, piezoelectric constants e_31, e_33, dielectric constant ε^S_33, density ρ, and coupling coefficient k_33.

resources.notes: No single access point is specified; the constants are well‑known and the solver can retrieve them from standard references or a reliable online database.
